title: Inclusive Radiation and Backreaction from the Phase-Space S-Matrix
summary: We develop a phase-space description of classical scattering in which the matter sector of the Dyson S-matrix is partially Weyl transformed while the radiation sector remains operator valued. The resulting S-matrix symbol provides a common origin for several classical observables: we show that the inclusive waveform, the classical displacement in phase-space (i.e. the impulse and position shift), and the angular momentum arise as different projections of the same object.
